_note: Game settings (plan S1, Tim 2026-10-19): the numbers you pick before a game, in one place. The game (src/main.js) lays these over the detail files (units.json, civilians.json, bandits.json, police.json), so a number here wins over the same number there; Node tests use the detail files as they are. Later a settings menu before a game (and a multiplayer host) picks from this same file. Seconds, ryo and world units; tune in playtests.

dayNight._note: the clock runs on its own (auto); N still flips it at once and starts that half fresh. Tim 2026-10-19: 4 min day, 6 min night

townsfolk._note: total across all types; each type keeps its share of civilians.json counts

police._note: officersPerTier: Quiet, Watched, Wanted, Manhunt, Most Wanted

businesses._note: price = buy an unclaimed one (about 4 payouts); payout = ryo at every dawn, none during a police Manhunt; attackWaves = police waves when you attack it unclaimed (plus 1 per heat tier); crewSlots = crew it adds to your cap (Tim 2026-10-19: by type, no hard cap); score = season points while you own it (Tim 2026-10-20: weighted by size)

territory._note: territory (sim/territory.js, Tim 2026-10-20): radius = street around each owned business that is your clan's (nearest business wins where they overlap); in your own territory you see every unit but hidden ninja, healFactor x faster slow healing, heat cools 1 every heatCoolSeconds, crew move crewSpeed x faster; quarterBonus = extra share of payout for holding every business in a quarter; a rival clan walking in alerts you at most once every intruderAlertSeconds per business

season._note: the season ends after this many day/night cycles (dawns); the clan with the highest score wins (business scores above; Shinobi Renown: renownPerPoint Renown = 1 point; Tim 2026-10-21: 50, so a good Shinobi season is about 5 points)

warLantern._note: a War Lantern: needed to raid a rival-owned business; bought at the moneylender's door

hideout._note: home hideouts (inn: you, izakaya: the rival clan): never taken; hire there hireTimeFactor x slower; heat cools heatCoolFactor x faster with the boss inside; rest heals restPerSecond of max HP a second
